name: Seen Health · Alhambra
coordinateSystem: right-handed; +x east in source plan, +y up, +z toward Valley Blvd.

source.title: SeenHealth_240111Render E WITH SF AREAS copy.pdf
source.author: Langdon Wilson International

calibration.notes: Uniform scale calibrated to clinic program area. Assumes the stated area corresponds to the traced perimeter. Net/gross area basis remains unverified; no survey tolerance can be claimed.

levels.name: Basement
levels.notes: 6,191 sq ft stated; basement perimeter follows the visible stacking diagram. No dimensioned basement plan or internal room schedule is supplied.

levels.name: Ground floor
levels.notes: Ground floor is the model elevation datum. Horizontal scale is calibrated from the clinic area, not surveyed dimensions.

levels.name: Mezzanine / second floor
levels.notes: Equipment mezzanine and future office footprints are shown. Their floor elevations and proposed second-floor modifications are not supplied.

levels.name: Roof
levels.notes: Roof form follows the stacking diagram and day-room sections. Roof, parapet, and equipment heights remain inferred.

zones.name: Clinic
zones.notes: Clinic perimeter calibrated to 3,254 sq ft. Six numbered exam rooms are visible. Rooms 1110, 1111, 1129 and 1130 are named in the presentation; exact numeric locations of all rooms are not recoverable from the compressed floor plan.

zones.name: Physical therapy
zones.notes: Southwest therapy wing, with treatment bays, therapy equipment, personal-care rooms and mezzanine above. Published 3,080 sq ft is shared with the rear PT/OT program; it is not a gross footprint for this rectangle.

zones.name: Rear PT / OT & support
zones.notes: Zone 02 also appears at the rear of the ground-floor stacking diagram. Individual support-room names and zone boundaries need the room schedule.

zones.name: Lobby & reception
zones.notes: Reception, enclosed offices and support rooms traced from the final overhead plan. Overall 3,150 sq ft lobby/back-of-house program includes other circulation and support rooms.

zones.name: East hallway
zones.notes: Hallway 1010. Storage cubbies, handrail, doors, tiled floor and suspended ceiling are shown in the elevations and perspectives.

zones.name: Day room
zones.notes: 3,665 sq ft is the published dayroom/memory-care program, not this single polygon. Page 66–67 explicitly dimensions the wall treatment datum at 12 ft, with a 4 ft lower band and 8 ft upper field. Roof crown above is inferred.

zones.name: Dining · 1421
zones.notes: Dining room 1421. Tables, display wall, kitchen service opening, lattice divider and green doors are shown. Furniture counts vary across views; plan placement is used.

zones.name: Kitchen
zones.notes: Kitchen is separate from dining and totals 638 sq ft in the area schedule. Internal equipment specifications are not supplied; visible counters are traced from page 12.

zones.name: Veranda / east edge
zones.notes: The east-edge connection is visible on the overall plan. Page 7 is a mood board, not an as-built perspective. Detailed enclosure and seating require confirmation.

zones.name: Administration
zones.notes: Shared workstations, offices, stairs and meeting rooms follow the final plan. Source perspectives establish glazed meeting fronts, light timber desks and dark carpet.

zones.name: Adjacent building
zones.notes: Adjacent building is visible with its roof in the final set. This document supplies no interior fit-out. It is retained as a context shell; the 2023 future-expansion label is no longer treated as a current room program.

zones.name: Basement
zones.notes: 6,191 sq ft stated. No basement room layout, openings, access details or height are supplied; the model contains a perimeter shell only.

zones.name: Equipment mezzanine
zones.notes: 1,267 sq ft stated. L-shaped extent follows the upper-level diagram. Exact edge offsets, structure, height and equipment are unverified.

zones.name: Future office space
zones.notes: 2,885 sq ft stated. Unfitted shell only. User-mentioned second-floor changes remain pending; no proposed offices or furniture have been invented.

accuracyIssues.title: Overall and room dimensions
accuracyIssues.detail: Need DWG/IFC/Revit or a dimensioned as-built plan; pixel tracing plus area calibration cannot establish exact lengths, door widths or wall thicknesses.

accuracyIssues.title: Floor-to-floor elevations
accuracyIssues.detail: Basement depth, mezzanine elevation, second-floor elevation and most roof/parapet heights are not dimensioned.

accuracyIssues.title: Second-floor changes
accuracyIssues.detail: User has mentioned additional updates; revised partitions, uses, access and furniture are pending.

accuracyIssues.title: Basement plan
accuracyIssues.detail: No basement partitions, doors, furniture or access plan provided.

accuracyIssues.title: Installed furniture and equipment
accuracyIssues.detail: Need manufacturer models/dimensions and location schedule. Pages 75 and 76 show different chairs in the same scene.

accuracyIssues.title: Room names and numbering
accuracyIssues.detail: 1110 consult, 1111 triage, 1010 hallway, 1129/1130 clinic and 1421 dining are named. Other room IDs and precise mapping need a numbered plan.

accuracyIssues.title: Site dimensions and street imagery
accuracyIssues.detail: Source includes architectural street renderings, not a surveyed civil site plan or current photographs. Curbs, lanes, trees and adjacent buildings cannot be certified from these views.

accuracyIssues.title: Net versus gross area boundaries
accuracyIssues.detail: Published program areas total 17,318 sq ft. Exact departmental boundaries and inclusions are not defined on the overhead plan; do not force every gross traced polygon to match a net program area.

accuracyIssues.title: Adjacent building interior
accuracyIssues.detail: Final document shows an adjacent roofed shell; its internal rooms and future use are not supplied.

accuracyIssues.title: Concealed construction / complete inventory
accuracyIssues.detail: Structural sizes, MEP routing, full ceiling plans, fire/life-safety devices, door/window schedules and hidden conditions are not exhaustively documented in this presentation.
